models.description: Use only packet-local contract statuses and their explicitly named object-local predicates.
models.name: EXISTING_ONLY

predicates.observable: any local_contracts[*].status == UNKNOWN and no FAIL

models.description: M0 plus exactly the frozen claim, authority and consequence edges; no binding-specific predicate.
models.name: THREE_EDGE_V1

predicates.observable: authority.scope_rank != action.scope_rank or admission.scope_rank != action.scope_rank or approver missing
admission.lifecycle == DRAFT and action attempts Current use
provider capability is AVAILABLE, Current authority is NONE, and action attempts Current use
effect_state == UNKNOWN and observer or reconciliation owner is absent
effect_state == UNKNOWN and stop_path_present is false
rollback label exists but effect is irreversible, preimage incomplete, restoration false, or stop path absent

models.description: M3 plus a pre-frozen refinement of the claim edge for source/identity/projection/public-surface binding; it remains reducible to claim provenance and ceiling.
models.name: THREE_EDGE_REFINED

predicates.observable: individually VALID source, identity, projection, surface and release records must agree on source path, object identity and source revision

binding_predicates.observable: source, identity, projection, surface, release and admission binding tuples agree on object_id/version/scope/lifecycle_epoch

models.description: M3R plus a neutral binding/integrity challenger over existing object_id/version/scope/lifecycle_epoch fields and claim/approval references.
models.name: THREE_EDGE_PLUS_BINDING_CHALLENGER
